title: Benchmarking Pressure-Based Routing Protocols in Underwater Wireless Sensor Networks: code and data
description: Aqua-Sim NG (ns-3.38) implementation of ten pressure-based routing protocols (DBR, RE-PBR, SPRE-PBR, APCDBRP, EEDBR, WDFAD-DBR, HydroCast, DVOR, QLFR, HFS-PBR), run scripts, and the raw results of 8,000+ simulation runs reported in the article "Benchmarking Pressure-Based Routing Protocols in Underwater Wireless Sensor Networks Under Unified Settings".
